bull_argument.argument:
Maybank's constructive case combines observed banking resilience with a fresh regional business-development event. The dated June 30 release reports CET1 of 14.92%, total capital 18.68%, and reported LCR of 130.0% and NSFR of 113.4%, while Q2 profit improved and NIM reached 2.10%. The October 29 Singapore MYR corporate-account launch adds a cross-border banking opportunity, without a quantified group earnings claim.

The completed close of RM10.00 and positive MACD indicate stabilization with approximately average volume. First-half profit was slightly below the previous year and the bank statements are 122 days old, so a sustained acceleration or cheap valuation is not established. A patient income-and-resilience allocation remains plausible, contingent on fresh credit and funding evidence rather than relying on the historic 31 sen payout as a guarantee.
key_points: Observed bank-specific capital and liquidity support resilience.
Fresh cross-border product launch creates an unquantified opportunity.
Daily technicals indicate stabilization, not a confirmed larger reversal.
Old statements, H1 softness and unavailable valuation constrain conviction.

bear_argument.argument:
Maybank's old capital and liquidity observations preserve a resilience scenario but do not establish the return from a new purchase. June30 statements are122 days old, H1 profit remains slightly below the prior year, and neither updated dividend coverage nor validated valuation is available. The Singapore corporate-account launch is a real business-development event with no quantified group earnings impact supplied.

The October29 close atRM10.00 is below the 50- and200-day averages. Approximately average volume and positive MACD improve the stabilization evidence but do not confirm a sustained reversal. Income-and-resilience ownership may remain reasonable, while fresh margin, credit and valuation evidence are still needed before adding on a recovery narrative.
key_points: Capital and credit information are122 days old.
One-quarter recovery does not establish H1 acceleration.
New product launch has no measured group profit impact.
Valuation, dividend coverage and larger trend confirmation remain missing.
bear_argument.rebuttal_to_previous: The bull's constructive case is explicitly conditional on the same fresh evidence the bear requests. A verified account launch and bank buffers do not resolve current price attractiveness, and past31sen distribution does not establish future income sustainability.

bull_argument.argument:
The bear correctly refuses to turn the new Singapore account offering into a group profit forecast. It is a fresh observed business-development opportunity alongside dated bank resilience: CET1 14.92%, total capital18.68%,LCR130% andNSFR113.4%. Q2 profit recovery and NIM2.10% provide a basis for a constructive banking-franchise scenario, not guaranteed future yield.

June30 evidence is122days old and first-half earnings slightly lower, so neither sustained acceleration nor current cheapness is established. Stabilizing daily momentum adds limited confirmation rather than a larger reversal. The strongest positive case remains patient income-and-resilience exposure, conditional on fresh funding, credit and dividend-coverage evidence; it does not require inventing a stronger immediate-add conclusion.
key_points: Observed bank buffers support resilience without a regulatory-threshold comparison.
Fresh product launch is opportunity, not measured earnings.
Q2 recovery is distinct from H1 acceleration.
Conditional income thesis survives while current valuation remains unknown.
bull_argument.rebuttal_to_previous: The bear is right that the purchase price and future dividend coverage remain unverified. My narrower rebuttal is that old-but-observed capital/liquidity and margin recovery preserve a credible franchise-income case; they justify continued consideration without implying the missing fresh evidence has already arrived.

bear_argument.argument:
The bull preserves a credible franchise-income scenario but concedes that current price and dividend coverage are not established. Reported June 30 capital, liquidity and NIM are useful observations, yet they are 122 days old and first-half earnings were slightly below the prior year. The fresh Singapore account launch has no quantified group profit contribution in the evidence.

Completed daily stabilization at RM10.00 does not resolve the larger trend below both major averages or establish fair value. The historical 31 sen distribution is not a forecast of sustainable future payout. Patient ownership can be reasonable while a fresh add waits for updated credit, margins, coverage or valuation; no claim of failed capital buffers is necessary for that more selective stance.
key_points: Dated observed buffers do not establish today's entry value.
Fresh product expansion remains unquantified in group profits.
H1 softness and missing dividend coverage limit the income-add case.
Stabilization remains short of a confirmed larger reversal.
bear_argument.rebuttal_to_previous: The second bull round explicitly treats fresh funding, credit and payout evidence as conditions that have not yet arrived. That maintains consideration of the franchise, but aligns with the bear's objection to adding now rather than resolving it.

bull_case_summary: Reported capital and liquidity, Q2 margin/profit recovery and a fresh cross-border account launch preserve a patient income-and-resilience scenario.
bear_case_summary: Statements remain122 days old, H1 earnings were slightly lower and neither dividend coverage nor valuation is verified; the new launch has no quantified group profit effect.
key_points_of_agreement: Q2 profit recovered but H1 profit was slightly below prior year.
Reported capital and liquidity observations are June30 data.
The new product launch is real but its group earnings effect is unquantified.
Technical stabilization is not a confirmed larger trend reversal.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether a patient franchise-income case warrants fresh capital before current valuation and credit evidence.
unresolved_uncertainties: Updated funding margin and asset quality.
Quantified economics of the new regional product.
